english.title: Fail to hand over the written permission / comply with the permission conditions on Croydon Tramlink property
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person undertaking an activity referred to in Byelaw 8(1), (2) or (3) of the Croydon Tramlink Byelaws, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ACTIVITY UNDERTAKEN..), and to whom written permission had been given by the Operator, failed to

(A)_[have the written permission with you and hand it over for inspection when asked to do so by an authorised person]_
(B)_[comply with the conditions attached to the written permission, namely **(..SPECIFY THE CONDITIONS BROKEN..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 8(4) and 26 of the Croydon Tramlink Byelaws made under section 46 of the Croydon Tramlink Act 1994.
